Aluminium demand outlook to 2035

The International Aluminium Institute publishes a regular assessment of global aluminium demand by end-use sector, covering transport, construction, packaging and electrical applications. The latest edition projects demand growth driven by vehicle lightweighting and grid expansion.

The full report, including regional demand tables and methodology, is available as a PDF download below. Members and the public may cite the report with attribution.

Download the full report (PDF, 4.2 MB)

Earlier editions and the underlying statistical series are available in the statistics section of this website, updated quarterly with primary production data.
